display.purpose: Page titles and empty-state headlines. Inter black (900), tight leading.

title.purpose: Exercise names, section labels, button text. The most common heavy element.

body.purpose: Notes and supporting copy. Inter medium (500).

label.purpose: Tiny badges and set-index chips at 10-11px, black weight.

numeric.purpose: Rest timer and all live rep/weight readouts. IBM Plex Mono, tabular-nums.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Card rest state. Barely-there separation from the cream paper.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Popovers and the cheer speech bubble.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and sheets that sit clearly above the page.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrances and the celebration. Soft, no bounce.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Session rows and reveals rising into place.

motion.name: cheer-hold-ms
motion.purpose: How long the finished-exercise mascot lingers before exiting.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.84 0.16 86); color: oklch(0.18 0.015 75); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, filter 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.84 0.16 86); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Add Set Button
components.description: Additive optional action, signalled by a dashed border.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-add"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Add Set</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-add { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: oklch(0.982 0.018 83); color: oklch(0.18 0.015 75); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px dashed oklch(0.85 0.035 82); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-add:hover { background: oklch(0.89 0.035 83); }

components.name: Rest Timer Pill
components.description: Glanceable rest countdown. Mono digits on espresso so they read fast mid-set.
components.css: .ds-pill-timer { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: oklch(0.18 0.015 75); color: oklch(0.84 0.16 86); padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.18 0.015 75); border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill-timer span { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Set Done Check
components.description: Marks a set complete. Fill plus check icon carry the state together so it survives color blindness. Disabled until reps > 0.
components.html: <button class="ds-check ds-check--done" aria-label="Set done"><svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-check { width: 24px; height: 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid oklch(0.85 0.035 82); background: transparent; color: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-check:hover { border-color: oklch(0.58 0.13 146 / 0.5); } .ds-check--done { background: oklch(0.58 0.13 146); border-color: oklch(0.58 0.13 146); color: oklch(0.982 0.018 83); } .ds-check:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Exercise Card
components.description: The core log container. Pronounced 24px radius, 2px structural border, soft warm lift.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(0.982 0.018 83); border: 2px solid oklch(0.85 0.035 82); border-radius: 24px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -18px rgb(29 26 20 / 0.24); } .ds-card__head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-card__idx { width: 20px; height: 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.89 0.035 83); color: oklch(0.49 0.02 75); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 10px; } .ds-card__name { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.62 0.18 38); }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Glanceable session progress. Fills with champion gold per completed set.
components.css: .ds-progress { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: oklch(0.982 0.018 83); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-progress__label, .ds-progress__pct { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.18 0.015 75); } .ds-progress__pct { color: oklch(0.49 0.02 75); } .ds-progress__track { flex: 1; height: 6px; background: oklch(0.89 0.035 83); border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress__fill { height: 100%; background: oklch(0.84 0.16 86); border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.overview: TUFF looks like a well-worn training log left open on a chalk-dusted bench, not a fitness app. The surface is warm cream paper; ink is dark espresso; the one color that shines is a champion gold, the color of a medal and of effort under good light. It is unapologetically physical and warm, reads at a glance with tired eyes in bad gym lighting, then rewards a finished set with a real jolt of pride. The system rejects the three traps strength apps fall into: neon dark-mode tactical-LED apps, cold corporate SaaS dashboards, and clinical white-and-teal health products. Warmth is the whole point.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream + espresso ground, champion gold as the rare reward color.
Heavy Inter (900) for labels and headings; IBM Plex Mono for all live numerics.
Soft, warm, downward shadows that lift cards gently off the paper, never hard edges.
Generous one-handed tap targets; compact vertical rhythm.
Motion and color are earned by real effort, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Earned Rule
rules.body: Champion gold never decorates. It marks the active thing or a primary action and stays under ~10% of any screen. If gold is everywhere, it means nothing.

rules.name: The Green-Means-Done Rule
rules.body: Rep green is reserved exclusively for completion and always travels with a check icon or shape so the state survives color blindness.

rules.name: The No-True-Black Rule
rules.body: The darkest value is Espresso Ink (L 0.18, tinted warm), never #000. Every neutral is tinted toward the warm hue.

rules.name: The Black-Weight Rule
rules.body: Structural and motivational text is font-black (900), not semibold. Hierarchy comes from weight and size contrast, not color.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every live or comparative number uses IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums and never reflows as it ticks.

rules.name: The Warm-Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows are espresso-tinted and always cast downward and soft. A hard, gray, or upward shadow is forbidden.

dos: Do keep champion gold under ~10% of the screen, on the active thing or the one primary action.
Do reserve rep green for completion only, always paired with a check icon.
Do set all live numbers in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums.
Do use font-black (900) Inter for structure and labels; let weight and space carry hierarchy.
Do cast soft, warm, downward espresso-tinted shadows for depth.
Do keep tap targets >=44px where the thumb lands, and gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion.
Do celebrate a finished exercise loudly. The win is the point.
donts: Don't ship a neon dark-mode gym look: no black grounds, electric green/blue glow, or glowing cards.
Don't drift into a corporate SaaS dashboard: no cold gray KPI grids or Material chrome.
Don't go clinical white-and-teal or strip out warmth to look trustworthy.
Don't use #000 or #fff; the darkest is Espresso Ink, every neutral tinted warm.
Don't use a border-left/border-right over 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use gradient text or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't rely on color alone for the done state, and never let a live number reflow as it changes.
